summary: Complete testing of Resume Builder entry flow rebuild (iteration 25). All 12 features tested successfully. Backend APIs (suggest-skills, generate-summaries) working correctly (9/9 pytest tests passed). Frontend flows: Entry page with 'AI Resume Builder' heading and teal accent, two pill buttons (amber 'Import your resume', blue 'Create my resume'), Upload page with drag-and-drop zone, browse button, paste option, 'Create a new resume' link, Processing screen with animated loader and rotating tips, Welcome screen with personalized greeting and SVG illustration, Analysis screen with 'You got it right' and 'How we'll help you improve' sections, Template selection, and Wizard editor with dark sidebar and score widget - all working correctly.
